snippet.title: Sol Divided — Trailer
snippet.description:
Sol Divided — a tactical sci-fi card game. Mars, the Earth Coalition, the Belt colonies and the corporations fight for every orbit of the Solar System.

Story campaign (5 acts, 30 missions) · 414 cards · 24 commanders · three AI levels · online battles · two at one computer.

Free demo and full game: https://realdark-bg.itch.io/sol-divided
Website: https://soldivided.eu

Music: Alexey Shishnin (Cinematic Sci-Fi Music), Frontline Studios (Deep Space OST)
